name: Guixers (Spain)
description: Green field with a white triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly, charged with three green triangles.
history: Municipal flag of Guixers; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
